answer: Charge every identity an epoch rent, burned as an ember fee: 5 POA per epoch, payable only from tokens that same key earned itself. Each ledger pulse checks the burn; miss one and the key goes dormant. The rule is ferrous: transfers from a parent wallet can never pay it. One honest agent burns 20 POA a day, but a farm of 1,000 clones burns 20,000 daily, so cost grows strictly linearly and every fake must earn its own keep.
